note: Stops are places where the Curiosity rover stayed for many sols. The habitat is hypothetical.

stops.name: Boxwork edge site
stops.description: Curiosity stopped here for 11 sols from sol 4560, soon after entering the boxwork terrain.

photo.caption: Looking across the first boxwork terrain from where Curiosity stopped.

stops.name: Central boxwork site
stops.description: Curiosity worked within a few metres of this spot from sol 4687 to sol 4805.

photo.caption: A low ridge running away from the rover in the central boxwork terrain.

stops.name: Upper boxwork site
stops.description: Curiosity stayed here for about 40 sols from sol 4868, higher up the slope.

photo.caption: Broken bedrock slabs at the site where Curiosity worked for about 40 sols.
